content.text: Hungarian Tarokk is the 42-card tarot game generally known as H?szash?v?sos or Paskievics Tarokk. Four active players bid, exchange with the talon, call the XX to choose a partner, and score both card points and announced bonuses.
Part of the Central European Tarot tradition, which arrived in Hungary from Austria in the 19th century.
4 players (2 vs 2 or 3 vs 1 depending on bidding).
42 cards: 22 Trumps (labeled I to XXI + Skylark/Sküs) and 20 suit cards (King, Queen, Cavalier, Jack and 10/Ace).
